items: Melt the butter in a large microwave-safe glass bowl (at least 10-cup capacity).
Add all ingredients except milk and stir well.
Microwave on high for 13 minutes. To be safe, put a plate under your bowl in case it starts to boil over.
Remove from microwave and stir again.
Pour hot caramel into a buttered 9x13 pan and allow to cool.
Cut into 1-inch squares and wrap in wax paper.
